svg.title: Proposed Solution A: Event-Based Decomposition of finalizeOrder()

g.text: Proposed Solution A: Event-Based Decomposition of finalizeOrder()
Handler is SKIPPED or returns immediately
1. Testable - Each handler tested in isolation
2. Extensible - Add/remove handlers without modifying core
5. Recoverable - Retry individual steps on failure
2. Calls finalizeOrder() with overridden Order model
This gives us extension points without
breaking OXID core or other modules.
